sources.name: Search Engine Roundtable
sources.excerpt: Google On robots.txt Rules For AI Crawlers, Emojis, International URLs & More. Gary Illyes and Chery Prommawin released their second video in the Non-Canonical Cabinet series; this one is named What can you actually put in a robots.txt? Here they discuss what is, and is not, supported by robots.txt files. And while Google may support features or directives, other search engines or AI crawlers might not.

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: New blog post: GEO is a distraction. I looked at 12 months of GA4 data across 100 sites - more than 145 million…

sources.name: Marie_Haynes
sources.excerpt: New blog post: GEO is a distraction. I looked at 12 months of GA4 data across 100 sites - more than 145 million sessions. ChatGPT sent 0.62% of the traffic Google organic did. With all the other LLMs included, it's 0.73%. While ChatGPT visitors converted better at 13.8% vs 3.02% for Google organic, Google still drove 27x more conversions than all the other LLMs combined. And remember how we thought ChatGPT visitors would increase exponentially? Overall visits from ChatGPT have actually been declining since GPT-5 came out in August 2025. I think GEO is a distraction. Google is the surface that's likely sending the most visitors to your business. Yes, AI is changing how people use the web,…
sources.author: @Marie_Haynes
